A '''''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle''' was used by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang of pirates]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] could be launched from a [[Surronian cruiser]]-based [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]] and land on surfaces too small for the mothership. It was at least 1/11 the size of the carrier vessel. The saucer craft had a dual cockpit design, with [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] canopies on the dorsal surface of the saucer.<ref name="DC" />

On the ventral side, the vessel had two thrusters, two laser cannons, two [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] launchers and three boarding ramps. Two on the front side leading towards the two cockpits and another one located on the back for passengers/cargo.<ref name="TGG" /> Like all [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttles]] owned by Ohnaka, the mark of his pirate gang was painted on both sides of the ship.<ref name="DC" />

==History==
The ship transported [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and Ohnaka from [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] to the surface of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="DC" /> Later, an [[Barb Mentir/Legends|accomplice]] of [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of Ohnaka used the saucer to attack and take down a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] carrying a [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] proving that the craft was very capable as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] against enemy craft.<ref name="TGG" />
